args.title: Fix password reset emails linking to localhost
args.body: File: src/notifications/templates.ts. BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is unset, which is being used to build the password reset link (and other links) sent in emails. Ensure PUBLIC_URL is properly configured/set in the deployment environment, and consider making the code fail loudly or use a correct production default when PUBLIC_URL is missing, so reset links never resolve to localhost for real users.
